nodes.name: PLAL in water
nodes.procedure: PLAL was performed by using Nd:YAG laser (Surelite II-10) with 1064 nm wavelength and 100 mJ per pulse power. The beam was collected using a 30 mm focusing lens on the Co plate immersed in 10 mL water for 20 min. The resultant solution was centrifuged, rinsed with absolute ethanol a few times, and dried at 100°C overnight.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD confirms monoclinic Co₃(PO₄)₂ (JCPDS 00-041-0375), cubic Co₃O₄ (JCPDS 00-042-1467), cubic Co₉S₈ (JCPDS 00-065-1765) with trace oxidized/metallic Co peaks; Table S1 reports Co₃O₄ crystallite size D=8.93 nm, highest lattice strain ε=1.22%.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 1b shows the XRD patterns... characteristic sharp peaks corresponding to those in JCPDS card numbers 00-041-0375, 00-042-1467, and 00-065-1765... Table S1, Supporting Information, presents the results of the calculated crystalline size (D), lattice strain (ε), and d-spacing (d)... lowest D (8.93 nm) and the highest ε (1.22%) for Co₃O₄.

nodes.characterization_summary: Raman spectra show Co₃(PO₄)₂ with sharp peak ~1000 cm⁻¹ (PO₄³⁻ ν₃ stretching) and low-intensity ν₂/ν₃ modes; Co₃O₄ with five active bands (A₁g, E_g, 3×F₂g) confirming cubic spinel; Co₉S₈ with Co-S vibration 200-400 cm⁻¹ plus oxide bands.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Raman spectra also confirmed the Co₃(PO₄)₂, Co₃O₄, and Co₉S₈ formations (Figure 1c)... The Co₃(PO₄)₂ spectrum exhibited a sharp peak around 1000 cm⁻¹... pure Co₃O₄ contains five active Raman bands... Co₉S₈ spectrum reveals a sharp peak in the 200-400 cm⁻¹ wavenumbers region...

nodes.characterization_summary: Co 2p XPS: Co₃(PO₄)₂ shows Co²⁺/Co³⁺ at 781.9/784.9 eV (satellites 787.5/790.2 eV); Co₃O₄ dominated by Co³⁺ 780.8/796.1 eV + Co²⁺ 779.6/794.6 eV; Co₉S₈ mixed Co²⁺/Co³⁺ with Co-S at 779.8/795.6 eV. P 2p 133.3 eV (PO₄³⁻), O 1s 531.3/532.8 eV (Co₃(PO₄)₂), S 2p 162.5/164.8/168.7/169.5 eV (S²⁻/S₂²⁻/SO₄²⁻/HSO₄⁻).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-resolution Co 2p spectra... exhibit two major peaks around 785 eV and above 795 eV... In the deconvoluted Co 2p spectrum of Co₃(PO₄)₂, the most pronounced peaks at 781.9 eV... P 2p spectrum... 133.3 eV... S 2p exhibited peaks at 162.5, 164.8, 168.7, and 169.5 eV...

nodes.characterization_summary: FE-SEM with EDS mapping shows Co₃(PO₄)₂ as 2D lamellar sheets, Co₃O₄ and Co₉S₈ as spherical NPs with homogeneous Co/O/S/P elemental distribution.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The FE-SEM images of Co₃(PO₄)₂ are presented in a 2D lamellar structure... whereas Co₃O₄ and Co₉S₈ appeared as spherical NPs. The EDS elemental mapping images depicted the presence of homogeneously dispersed elements...

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM confirms Co₃O₄ lattice planes (220) 2.86 Å, (311) 2.44 Å, (400) 2.02 Å; Co₉S₈ (311) 2.99 Å, (440) 1.73 Å matching XRD high-intensity peaks.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The estimated interplanar distances of 2.86, 2.44, and 2.02Å are indexed to the (220), (311), and (400) planes of Co₃O₄, respectively... interplanar spacing of 2.99 and 1.73Å are attributed to the (311) and (440) planes of Co₉S₈, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ EC-Raman on Co₃(PO₄)₂ during OER shows surface reconstruction to CoO(OH) (peak at 508 cm⁻¹) and further to Co₃O₄ (peaks at 686.9, 480.5, 524.9 cm⁻¹) under oxidizing potentials.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The in situ EC-Raman spectroscopy was performed to determine the reason for the enhanced OER performance of Co₃(PO₄)₂... new peak at 508 cm⁻¹ (♠) appeared due to the Co-O of the CoO(OH) Raman bands.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ EC-Raman on Co₉S₈ during HER shows formation of amorphous Co(OH)₂ (peaks at 501, 522 cm⁻¹) as active species.
nodes.evidence_snippet: During the HER process, the in situ EC-Raman spectroscopy was performed... The most prominent peaks at 501 and 522 cm⁻¹ steadily grew with the potential, depicting a characteristic signal of amorphous Co(OH)₂...
